former_or_alternate_names: Sheraton Grand Danang Resort & Convention Center

sheraton-grand-da-nang.address: 35 Truong Sa Street, Ngu Hanh Son (formerly Hoa Hai Ward), Da Nang
sheraton-grand-da-nang.ward_district: Ngu Hanh Son (Hoa Hai Ward in older listings)
sheraton-grand-da-nang.neighborhood_note: NOT on My Khe Beach. It is on the Truong Sa coastal road in the Hoa Hai / Ngu Hanh Son area, about 8 km (OSRM 8.8 km drive) south of the southern end of the OSM My Khe Beach polygon. Trip.com/Golfasian copy describes the beach as Non Nuoc Beach (the southern continuation of the same sand strip, locally also called My Khe south). Our 'My Khe Beach / restaurant strip 5-10 min walk' framing is not supported.

marriott-resort-da-nang.official_name: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas
marriott-resort-da-nang.operator_owner: Marriott International (manager); Vinpearl (owner, per Hospitality Net)
former_or_alternate_names: Vinpearl Resort & Spa Da Nang (villa property)
marriott-resort-da-nang.name_note: TWO distinct Marriott properties sit side by side in Ngu Hanh Son: (a) Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas = all-villa, 23 Truong Sa, Trip.com 122 rooms, listed opened 2023; (b) Danang Marriott Resort & Spa = 07 Truong Sa, 239 rooms, opened 2022, rooms + suites + some villas, 2 outdoor pools, 5 restaurants. Our page uses the name of (a) but with a '200 villas / 2020' framing that matches neither.

marriott-resort-da-nang.neighborhood_note: Truong Sa coast next to Non Nuoc / Marble Mountains, about 6.8 km road south of the southern end of My Khe Beach. Not on My Khe. Trip lists Non Nuoc Beach 0.58 km (nearest public beach node).
